posts.title: Cupertino Lens for Mac Is Now in Beta
posts.description: Cupertino Lens for Mac is now in public beta: every Apple story, who broke it first, Apple's own server changes and the stock, live in beta in one free Mac app. The post Cupertino Lens for Mac Is Now in Beta first appeared on Cupertino Lens .
